platform: Windows x64; system .NET Framework 4.x and pinned PDFium
implementation: Directory file notifications, coalesced 350 ms stable-write checks, periodic metadata fallback; no new dependency
cases: same size and timestamp with notification
limits: Notifications are coalesced until the file is stable; a lock or invalid PDF delays reload.
Without notifications the periodic fallback detects metadata changes, not same-byte-length changes with all timestamps preserved.
Unchanged AI models and previous AI-specific accuracy checks were not rerun for this file-watching change.
